identity: Azorius (UW) lifegain-control. Blue permission (Counterspell, Force of Will, Absorb) and card advantage (Fact or Fiction, Deep Analysis, Thieving Magpie) deny the opponent's game plan while Wrath of God and Floodgate reset the board. White lifegain (Congregate, Renewed Faith, Spirit Link) and Absorb bank life behind the wall; the deck closes with protected evasive flyers (Lyra Dawnbringer, Serra Angel, Thieving Magpie) and Test of Endurance as a Wrath-proof 50-life inevitability.

pitch: The primary win is the flyer/attrition line, not Test of Endurance. Lyra, Serra Angel and Thieving Magpie, protected by Counterspell/Absorb/Force of Will and refueled by Fact or Fiction/Deep Analysis, close most games. Test of Endurance is the deck's thematic Lifegain payoff and a Wrath-proof inevitability for the grindy games where the flyers get repeatedly answered — with only ~6 lifegain sources, reaching 50 is a long-game outcome, not a fast clock. The self-grill flagged this honestly and it is retained by design.

identity_es: Control Azorius (UW) de ganancia de vida. La permisión azul (Counterspell, Force of Will, Absorb) y la ventaja de cartas (Fact or Fiction, Deep Analysis, Thieving Magpie) niegan el plan del rival mientras Wrath of God y Floodgate reinician el tablero. La ganancia de vida blanca (Congregate, Renewed Faith, Spirit Link) y Absorb acumulan vida tras el muro; el mazo cierra con voladores evasivos protegidos (Lyra Dawnbringer, Serra Angel, Thieving Magpie) y con Test of Endurance como inevitabilidad de 50 vidas a prueba de Wrath.
pitch_es: La victoria principal es la línea de voladores y desgaste, no Test of Endurance. Lyra, Serra Angel y Thieving Magpie, protegidos por Counterspell/Absorb/Force of Will y reabastecidos por Fact or Fiction/Deep Analysis, cierran la mayoría de partidas. Test of Endurance es la recompensa temática de Ganancia de vida del mazo y una inevitabilidad a prueba de Wrath para las partidas largas en las que responden a los voladores una y otra vez: con solo ~6 fuentes de ganancia de vida, llegar a 50 es un resultado de partida larga, no un reloj rápido. Está así por diseño.
